rule_summary: Ordinary Discover and random card generation exclude their own collectible source card. Registered reviewed reprint families are excluded together, without merging candidate identities/weights. Physical-zone choices and explicitly named finite recipes retain their separate semantics. Apply ordinary source exclusion only to generation entry points and matching receipts, not all pure metadata/transform queries.
